enemy_distance.desc: Distance to the nearest enemy, in pixels (9999 when none is left)

enemy_bearing.desc: Where the nearest enemy is, in degrees from where the robot faces: negative to the left, positive to the right (-180 to 180)

gun_bearing.desc: Where the nearest enemy is, in degrees from where the gun points

enemy_in_sight.desc: Is the nearest enemy within 10 degrees of the gun?

near_wall.desc: Is a wall within 80 pixels straight ahead?

wall_distance.desc: Distance to the nearest wall, in pixels

gun_ready.desc: Has the gun cooled down enough to fire?

was_hit.desc: Was the robot hit by a bullet last turn?

speed.desc: The robot's speed, -8 to 8 pixels a turn

enemies_left.desc: How many enemies are still alive
